## RepeatOptions.key property

Selects a unique, stable key for each item. Matching keys retain their views across replacements and mutations. Views are never recycled between keys, regardless of the recycle option. Keys use Map equality semantics.

**Signature:**

```typescript
key?: (item: TItem) => unknown;
```
